# Zalven Calibration

> Zalven Calibration (also known as Zalven Calibration Shop) is a diesel fuel injection pump and
> injector calibration, testing, and repair shop in Caloocan City, Metro Manila, Philippines.
> It tests, repairs, and calibrates diesel fuel injection pumps and injectors for cars, trucks, and
> heavy equipment, servicing Isuzu, Mitsubishi, Toyota, Caterpillar, Perkins, Volvo, Mercedes-Benz,
> Hyundai, and Stanadyne engines, using genuine parts from Bosch, Delphi, Zexel, OMS, and
> Interstate-McBee. Open 6:00 AM - 8:00 PM every day at 967 Captain Samano St, Camarin Rd, Camarin,
> Caloocan, 1425 Metro Manila, Philippines.
